shortfall_reason: 20/20 supported text-only concepts after independent primary-body comparison of all 60 source-claim fields across 16 sources; no rejections. Compared against all 24 original speech entries: six explicit enrichment IDs, fourteen distinct concepts; general methods are not duplicated as specific creative dialogue examples. Titles, summaries, subtypes and tags remain within the cited teaching/provider scope. Prominence versus segmentation, linking versus palatalization, and visual grouping versus onset metadata are distinct, not wording variants. No observations, measurements, creative proposals or media candidates; no media acquired or reviewed. English lessons are not universal Korean rules; numbers enrichment does not verify proper names. Existing IDs and original authorship remain unchanged. Rights remain unknown, not cleared for media or bulk text reuse. No DB population or media acquisition is claimed.
